outcome: Rate of vaginal deliveries within 24 hours
cohort: Patients induced at term by prostaglandins with an unfavorable cervix, over two consecutive periods from 01/01/2019 to 19/02/2020 and from 20/02/2020 to 07/04/2021, within a regional level III university hospital center.
finding: There was no difference in efficacy between oral misoprostol and vaginal dinoprostone in terms of vaginal delivery rates within 24 hours or cesarean section rates, but oral misoprostol was better tolerated with lower rates of tachysystole and acidosis.
